description: This file contains code for probing authentication profiles and models, including building probe targets, executing probes with concurrency, and summarizing results. It manages interactions with external modules for cryptography, filesystem, and project-specific agents and configurations.

methods.name: loadEmbeddedRunnerModule
methods.description: Dynamically imports the embedded agent module for running probes.

methods.name: mapFailoverReasonToProbeStatus
methods.description: Converts a reason string into an AuthProbeStatus enum value.

methods.name: buildCandidateMap
methods.description: Builds a map of provider to list of model references from model candidates.

methods.name: selectProbeModel
methods.description: Selects a model for probing based on provider, candidates, and catalog.

methods.name: mapEligibilityReasonToProbeReasonCode
methods.description: Maps an eligibility reason code to a probe reason code.

methods.name: formatMissingCredentialProbeError
methods.description: Formats an error message for missing or invalid credentials.

methods.name: resolveProbeSecretRef
methods.description: Resolves a secret reference from a profile credential.

methods.name: formatUnresolvedRefProbeError
methods.description: Formats an error message for unresolved secret references.

methods.name: maybeResolveUnresolvedRefIssue
methods.description: Attempts to resolve secret references and returns an error if unresolved.

methods.name: buildProbeTargets
methods.description: Builds a list of probe targets and initial results based on providers and profiles.

methods.name: probeTarget
methods.description: Performs a probe on a specific target, executing embedded agent and capturing result.

methods.name: runTargetsWithConcurrency
methods.description: Runs multiple probe targets concurrently with progress reporting.

methods.name: runAuthProbes
methods.description: Main function to build probe targets and execute them, returning a summary.

methods.name: formatProbeLatency
methods.description: Formats latency in milliseconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: sortProbeResults
methods.description: Sorts probe results by provider and label/profileId.

methods.name: describeProbeSummary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of the probe summary.
